title: Model registry prompt source validation: prompt-tagged model versions accept only the two placeholder schemeless sources or scheme-bearing URIs
answers: Why does register_prompt or create_model_version return 400 'Invalid prompt source' when I pass a relative path as the source?
Which source values are allowed when creating a prompt model version through the REST API?
Why is a Windows drive-letter source like C:/data rejected for a prompt model version?
Where is the source check for prompt model versions handled in the server?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_create_model_version sends prompt-tagged CreateModelVersion requests (used by prompt registration via mlflow.genai.register_prompt, AbstractStore.create_prompt_version and the UI prompt-creation call) to mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source before any store call.
Rule: Classify the source with mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme, not urlparse. A non-empty, non-file scheme gets _validate_non_local_source_contains_relative_paths. Any other source, including empty, must exactly equal a member of mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS ("dummy-source" or "prompt-template"), otherwise it is rejected with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE. Windows drive letters (C:/...) classify as local because get_uri_scheme returns an empty scheme for them. When a Python sender needs a placeholder, add it to mlflow/prompt/constants.py and import it; do not hardcode the literal. The UI copy in mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/prompts/api.ts is the one exception and carries a pointer comment.
Symptom: Prompt-tagged create requests with a schemeless relative source such as "mlflow", ".", "etc/passwd" or "C:/Windows" were accepted and stored verbatim as the model version's artifact location. The model-version get-artifact endpoint then served files from the server's local filesystem through LocalArtifactRepository (path traversal / local file read, follow-up to GHSA-m65p-9j7q-6w33).
Constraints: Applies only when the effective mlflow.prompt.is_prompt tag is true (see the is_prompt tag rule). Regular model versions still go through _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model. An empty prompt source is now rejected too, so a REST caller creating a prompt must send one of the two placeholders. Remote schemes such as ftp:// are not restricted by this check; they only get the traversal check.
applies: Server-side validation of the source field on CreateModelVersion for prompt-tagged model versions in the model registry.
says: Registering a prompt fails with an invalid source error when given a local path.
Creating a prompt template rejects Windows drive paths and relative folder locations.
Saving a prompt with a blank source location returns an invalid parameter error.
Why does the prompt creation screen reject my custom local storage path?
Prevent security vulnerabilities where prompt versions read arbitrary local files from the server.
search: Server-side prompt validation in _validate_prompt_source requires prompt-tagged model version sources to have a non-empty, non-file URI scheme or match placeholders in _PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS. Relative paths, Windows drive letters, empty sources, and file schemes are rejected with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE to prevent local file read vulnerabilities via LocalArtifactRepository. This validation applies only when the effective mlflow.prompt.is_prompt tag is true, leaving regular model versions to undergo standard run and model source checks.
